-- This script is made for the mode Slap Royale in the game Slap Battles.
-- Low ping is recommended because delays can cause kicks so the recommended ping is 0 to 100 if your below this you should be fine.
-- This script has features that no other current script has (when writing this) and yes they work like anti acid and auto win.
-- This script has one of the best slap auras in slap royale so you will be able to kill exploiters easy as pie.
-- Huge thank you for choosing Pumpkin Hub!

local function ClearLine(a,b)
	local r=workspace:Raycast(a,b-a,RayParams)
	return not r
end

local function ClearFromTool(toolPos,targetPos)
	local r=workspace:Raycast(toolPos,targetPos-toolPos,RayParams)
	return not r
end

local function AvoidTools(pos)
	local newPos=pos
	for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Tool") then
			local handle=obj:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				local flatPos=Vector3.new(newPos.X,handle.Position.Y,newPos.Z)
				if (flatPos-handle.Position).Magnitude<3 then
					newPos=newPos+Camera.CFrame.RightVector*6
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return newPos
end

local function Ground(pos)
	local r=workspace:Raycast(pos+Vector3.new(0,40,0),Vector3.new(0,-200,0),RayParams)
	if r then
		local p=r.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
		return AvoidTools(p)
	else
		return AvoidTools(pos+Vector3.new(0,3,0))
	end
end

local function PickupTool(tool)

local function EnsureNotOnTool(target,toolPos)
	local flatTarget=Vector3.new(target.X,toolPos.Y,target.Z)
	if (flatTarget-toolPos).Magnitude<2 then
		local alt=Ground(toolPos+Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5)
		if math.abs(alt.Y-toolPos.Y)<=6 and ClearFromTool(toolPos,alt) then
			return alt
		end
		local alt2=Ground(toolPos-Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5)
		if math.abs(alt2.Y-toolPos.Y)<=6 and ClearFromTool(toolPos,alt2) then
			return alt2
		end
	end
	return target
end

local function BestSide(toolPos)
	local hrp=Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local baseY=toolPos.Y
	if not hrp then
		local g=Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY+3,toolPos.Z)
		return EnsureNotOnTool(AvoidTools(g),toolPos)
	end
	local sides={
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)+Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5,
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)-Camera.CFrame.RightVector*5,
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)+Camera.CFrame.LookVector*5,
		Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)-Camera.CFrame.LookVector*5
	}
	local best=nil
	local bestDist=math.huge
	for _,pos in ipairs(sides) do
		local g=AvoidTools(pos)
		if math.abs(g.Y-baseY)<=2 then
			if ClearFromTool(toolPos,g) then
				local d=(g-hrp.Position).Magnitude
				if d<bestDist then
					bestDist=d
					best=g
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if best then
		return EnsureNotOnTool(best,toolPos)
	end
	local fallback=Vector3.new(toolPos.X,baseY,toolPos.Z)
	return EnsureNotOnTool(AvoidTools(fallback),toolPos)
end

local function SafeTP(tool)
	local hrp=Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not hrp or not handle then return end
	local target=BestSide(handle.Position)
	target=AvoidTools(target)
	hrp.CFrame=CFrame.new(target,hrp.Position+hrp.CFrame.LookVector)
end

local function TPAndPickup(tool)
	SafeTP(tool)
	task.wait(0.1)
	PickupTool(tool)
	task.wait(0.5)

	local c = Player.Character

	ILEnabled = false
	CanCount = false

local function GetRoot()
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end

	return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function ProcessCrate(crate)
	if not AutoGetCrates then
		return
	end

	if not crate:IsA("Model") or crate.Name ~= "Crate" then
		return
	end

	local rootPart = GetRoot()
	if not rootPart then
		return
	end

	-- Get the crate's position
	local crateCFrame

	if crate.PrimaryPart then
		crateCFrame = crate.PrimaryPart.CFrame
	else
		crateCFrame = crate:GetPivot()
	end

	-- Teleport 10 studs underneath the crate
	local targetPosition =
		crateCFrame.Position - Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)

	rootPart.CFrame =
		CFrame.new(targetPosition) *
		(rootPart.CFrame - rootPart.CFrame.Position)

	-- Find Effects.Basic Flame Wisp
	local effects = crate:FindFirstChild("Effects", true)
	local basic = effects and effects:FindFirstChild("Basic")
	local flameWisp = basic and basic:FindFirstChild("Flame Wisp")

	-- Wait until Flame Wisp is disabled
	if flameWisp and flameWisp:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		while AutoGetCrates
			and crate.Parent
			and flameWisp.Enabled do

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end

	if not AutoGetCrates or not crate.Parent then
		return
	end

	-- Find GetItemFromCrate
	local remote = crate:FindFirstChild("GetItemFromCrate", true)

	if not remote then
		warn("GetItemFromCrate not found in crate:", crate:GetFullName())
		return
	end

	if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		remote:FireServer()

	elseif remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
		remote:InvokeServer()
	end
end

			Rayfield:Notify({
				Title = "Auto Get Crates",
				Content = "Workspace.Shipments.Crates not found.",
				Duration = 5
			})
			return
		end

		-- Process crates that already exist
		for _, crate in ipairs(cratesFolder:GetChildren()) do
			task.spawn(function()
				ProcessCrate(crate)
			end)
		end

		-- Process newly spawned crates
		task.spawn(function()

			while AutoGetCrates and cratesFolder.Parent do

				local connection

				connection = cratesFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(crate)
					if AutoGetCrates
						and crate:IsA("Model")
						and crate.Name == "Crate" then

						task.spawn(function()
							ProcessCrate(crate)
						end)
					end
				end)

				repeat
					task.wait(1)
				until not AutoGetCrates or not cratesFolder.Parent

				if connection then
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
})

--==================================================

--==================================================

local function FindAllowedTool(maxDistance)
	local currentChar = lp.Character
	local hrp = currentChar and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not hrp then
		return nil
	end

	local closest = nil
	local closestDistance = maxDistance or math.huge

	for _, tool in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

		if tool:IsA("Tool")
			and AllowedTools[tool.Name] then

			local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			if handle then

				local distance =
					(handle.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

				if distance < closestDistance then
					closestDistance = distance
					closest = tool
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

--==================================================

local function Pickup(handle)

	if not GetItemsEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if blocked or recoveryRunning then
		return false
	end

	if not CountdownAllowed() then
		return false
	end

	if not handle or not handle.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local id = handle:GetAttribute("ItemId")

	if not id then
		return false
	end

	ItemRemote:FireServer(id)

	local gui = handle:FindFirstChild("ItemGui")

	if gui then
		gui.Enabled = false
	end

	return true
end

local function TPToToolWithoutPickup(tool)

	if not tool or not tool.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local hrp =
		currentChar
		and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	if not hrp or not handle then
		return false
	end

	local toolPos = handle.Position

	local sideDirs = {
		Vector3.new(3, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(-3, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 3),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, -3)
	}

	local chosenSide = nil

	for _, dir in ipairs(sideDirs) do

		local ray = workspace:Raycast(
			toolPos,
			dir,
			RayParams
		)

		if not ray then
			chosenSide = dir
			break
		end
	end

	if chosenSide then

		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(
			toolPos + chosenSide,
			toolPos
		)

	else

		local rightVector

		if Camera then
			rightVector = Camera.CFrame.RightVector
		else
			rightVector = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
		end

		local sidePos =
			toolPos + rightVector * 4

		hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(
			sidePos,
			toolPos
		)
	end

	return true
end

	local bobaList = {}
	local speedList = {}
	local frogList = {}

	for _, obj in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

			local handle = obj:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			if handle then

				if obj.Name == "Bomb"
					and not BombPickedThisRound
					and not BombTeleportedThisRound
					and not bomb then

					bomb = obj

				elseif obj.Name == "Potion of Strength" then

					table.insert(
						strengthList,
						obj
					)

				elseif obj.Name == "Bull's essence" then

					table.insert(
						bullList,
						obj
					)

				elseif obj.Name == "Boba" then

					table.insert(
						bobaList,
						obj
					)

				elseif obj.Name == "Speed Potion" then

						obj
					)

				elseif obj.Name == "Frog Potion" then

					table.insert(

						obj

			end
		end

	return {

--==================================================

--==================================================

local function CollectItems(amount)

	if CollectionRunning then
		return 0
	end

	if not GetItemsEnabled then
		return 0
	end

	if blocked or recoveryRunning then
		return 0
	end

	if not CountdownAllowed() then
		return 0
	end

	CollectionRunning = true

	local picked = 0

	local order = GetOrderedItems()

	for _, group in ipairs(order) do

		for _, tool in ipairs(group) do

			if picked >= amount then
				break
			end

			if not GetItemsEnabled then
				break
			end

			if blocked or recoveryRunning then
				break
			end

			if not CountdownAllowed() then
				break
			end

			if tool and tool.Parent then

				-- Bomb may only be teleported to once.
				if tool.Name == "Bomb"
					and BombTeleportedThisRound then

					continue
				end

				local success =
					TPWaitLookPickup(tool)

				if success then

					picked += 1

					if tool.Name == "Bomb" then

						BombPickedThisRound = true
						BombTeleportedThisRound = true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if picked >= amount then
			break
		end
	end

	CollectionRunning = false

	return picked
end

--==================================================
-- START BUS COLLECTION
--==================================================

local function StartBusCollection()

	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then
		return
	end

	if ContinueAfterBusRunning then
		return
	end

	ContinueAfterBusRunning = true

	-- Stop normal item collection while inside bus.
	GetItemsEnabled = false
	CollectionRunning = false
	CollectionCooldown = false
	lastPicked = nil

	task.wait(0.5)

	-- Check toggle before jumping.
	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- JUMP OUT, THEN TELEPORT TO TOOL
	--==================================================

	if ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		-- Jump out first
		pcall(function()
			BusJumping:FireServer()
		end)

		-- Wait 0.1 seconds after jumping
		task.wait(0.1)

		if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then
			return
		end

		-- Look for a tool after the jump.
		-- Retry briefly in case the items have not loaded yet.
		local tool = nil

		for i = 1, 20 do

			if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then
				break
			end

			tool = FindAllowedTool(1000)

			if tool and tool.Parent then
				break
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		-- Teleport after the tool is found
		if ContinueAfterBusEnabled and tool and tool.Parent then
			TPToToolWithoutPickup(tool)
		end
	end

	--==================================================
	-- WAIT AFTER JUMP
	--==================================================

	task.wait(0.2)

	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- CONFIRM PLAYER IS OUT OF BUS
	--==================================================

	local startTime = tick()
	local exitedBus = false

	while tick() - startTime < 10 do

		if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

			GetItemsEnabled = false
			ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

			return
		end

		local currentChar = lp.Character
		local torso = GetTorso(currentChar)

		if torso and torso.Transparency < 1 then

			exitedBus = true
			break
		end

		task.wait(0.05)
	end

	if not exitedBus then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- WAIT 10 SECONDS AFTER JUMPING OUT
	--==================================================

	task.wait(10)

	if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		GetItemsEnabled = false
		ContinueAfterBusRunning = false

		return
	end

	--==================================================
	-- DELETE GLIDERS WHILE GET ITEMS IS ENABLED
	--==================================================

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if GetItemsEnabled then
				for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj.Name == "Glider" then
						pcall(function()
							obj:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- NOW TELEPORT TO BOMB
	--==================================================

	GetItemsEnabled = true

	if not BombTeleportedThisRound
		and ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

		local bomb = nil

		for _, tool in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

			if tool:IsA("Tool")
				and tool.Name == "Bomb"
				and tool.Parent then

				bomb = tool
				break
			end
		end

		if bomb then

			TPToToolWithoutPickup(bomb)

			BombTeleportedThisRound = true
		end
	end

	--==================================================
	-- COLLECT ITEMS
	--==================================================

	if ContinueAfterBusEnabled
		and GetItemsEnabled then

		local amount

		if CollectionCycle == 0 then
			amount = 4
		else
			amount = 7
		end

		local picked =
			CollectItems(amount)

		if picked > 0 then

			CollectionCycle += 1

			-- Always wait 5 seconds after
			-- the collection finishes.
			CollectionCooldown = true

			task.wait(5)

			CollectionCooldown = false
		end
	end

	ContinueAfterBusRunning = false
end

local function SetupBusMonitor(c)

	local leg = GetRightLeg(c)

	if not leg then
		return
	end

	local previousTransparency =
		leg.Transparency

	leg:GetPropertyChangedSignal(
		"Transparency"
	):Connect(function()

		local currentTransparency =
			leg.Transparency

		local becameInvisible =
			previousTransparency < 1
			and currentTransparency >= 1

		previousTransparency =
			currentTransparency

		if not becameInvisible then
			return
		end

		--==================================================
		-- CONTINUE OFF
		--==================================================

		if not ContinueAfterBusEnabled then

			-- Stay in bus.
			GetItemsEnabled = false

			return
		end

		--==================================================
		-- CONTINUE ON
		--==================================================

		if ContinueAfterBusRunning then
			return
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			StartBusCollection()
		end)

	end)
end

local function SetGetAllItemsNoclip(enabled)

	if GetAllItemsNoclipConnection then
		GetAllItemsNoclipConnection:Disconnect()
		GetAllItemsNoclipConnection = nil
	end

	if not enabled then

		local currentChar = lp.Character

		if currentChar then
			for _, obj in ipairs(currentChar:GetDescendants()) do
				if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
					obj.CanCollide = true
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	GetAllItemsNoclipConnection =

			if not currentChar then
				return
			end

			for _, obj in ipairs(currentChar:GetDescendants()) do
				if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
					obj.CanCollide = false
				end
			end
		end)
end

--==================================================
-- FIND CLOSEST TOOL
-- ALL TOOLS IN workspace.Items
--==================================================

local function FindClosestGetAllTool()

	local currentChar = lp.Character

	local hrp =
		currentChar
		and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not hrp then
		return nil
	end

	local closest = nil
	local closestDistance = math.huge

	for _, tool in ipairs(Items:GetChildren()) do

		-- Accept EVERY Tool in workspace.Items.
		if tool:IsA("Tool") then

			local handle =
				tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			if handle
				and handle:IsA("BasePart")
				and handle.Parent then

				local distance =
					(handle.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude

				if distance < closestDistance then

					closestDistance = distance
					closest = tool

				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

--==================================================
-- TWEEN TO TOOL
--==================================================

local function TweenToGetAllTool(tool)

	if not tool or not tool.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local currentChar = lp.Character

	local hrp =
		currentChar
		and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local handle =
		tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	if not hrp or not handle then
		return false
	end

	local targetPosition =
		handle.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 0)

	local targetCFrame =
		CFrame.new(
			targetPosition,
			handle.Position
		)

	local tweenInfo =
		TweenInfo.new(
			0.1,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
			Enum.EasingDirection.Out
		)

	local tween =
		TweenService:Create(
			hrp,
			tweenInfo,
			{
				CFrame = targetCFrame
			}
		)

	local finished = false

	local connection =
		tween.Completed:Connect(function()
			finished = true
		end)

	tween:Play()

	while not finished do

		if not GetAllItemsEnabled then

			tween:Cancel()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

			return false
		end

		if not tool.Parent then

			tween:Cancel()

			if connection then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end

			return false
		end

		task.wait()
	end

	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	return true
end

--==================================================
-- PICK UP TOOL
--==================================================

local function GetAllPickup(tool)

	if not GetAllItemsEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if not tool or not tool.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local handle =
		tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")

	if not handle then
		return false
	end

	local id =
		handle:GetAttribute("ItemId")

	if not id then
		return false
	end

	ItemRemote:FireServer(id)

	local gui =
		handle:FindFirstChild("ItemGui")

	if gui then
		gui.Enabled = false
	end

	return true
end

--==================================================
-- GET ALL ITEMS LOOP
--==================================================

local function StartGetAllItems()

	if GetAllItemsRunning then
		return
	end

	GetAllItemsRunning = true

	while GetAllItemsEnabled do

		-- Use the same countdown requirement.
		if CountdownAllowed() then

			-- Always get the closest remaining Tool.
			local tool =
				FindClosestGetAllTool()

			if tool then

				-- Tween to tool for 0.4 seconds.
				local arrived =
					TweenToGetAllTool(tool)

				if arrived
					and GetAllItemsEnabled
					and tool.Parent then

					-- Wait 0.4 seconds after arriving.
					task.wait(0.4)

					if GetAllItemsEnabled
						and tool.Parent then

						-- Pick it up.
						GetAllPickup(tool)

						-- Wait 2 seconds before
						-- going to the next tool.
						task.wait(2)
					end

				else
					task.wait(0.1)
				end

			else

				-- No tools currently available.
				task.wait(0.1)

			end

		else

			-- Wait for the countdown.
			task.wait(0.1)

		end
	end

	GetAllItemsRunning = false
end

local function GetTeam(inst)
    return inst:GetAttribute("RoundTeam")
end

local function IsEnemyPlayer(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if CONFIG.TargetTeam then return true end

    local myTeam, theirTeam = GetTeam(LocalPlayer), GetTeam(player)
    if myTeam == nil or theirTeam == nil then return true end
    return myTeam ~= theirTeam
end

local function IsEnemyBot(bot)
    if CONFIG.TargetTeam then return true end
    local myTeam, theirTeam = GetTeam(LocalPlayer), GetTeam(bot)
    if myTeam == nil or theirTeam == nil then return true end
    return myTeam ~= theirTeam
end

local function HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return true end

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType  = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local filter = { cam }
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(filter, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    local we = Workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponEffects")
    if we then table.insert(filter, we) end

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter

    local hit = Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, params)
    if not hit then return true end
    return hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function IsOnScreen(worldPos)
    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return false end
    local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
    if not onScreen then return false end
    if screenPos.Z <= 0 then return false end
    return true
end

local function ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, character, targetPart, best)
    if not targetPart then return best end

    if CONFIG.AliveCheck then
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return best end
    end

    if not CONFIG.IgnoreForceField then
        if character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return best end
    end

    local dir  = targetPart.Position - origin
    local dist = dir.Magnitude

    if dist <= 0.1 or dist > CONFIG.FOV then return best end

    local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(lookUnit:Dot(dir.Unit), -1, 1))

    if not CONFIG.FullCircle then
        if angle >= math.rad(CONFIG.AimCone) then return best end
        if CONFIG.OnScreenCheck and not IsOnScreen(targetPart.Position) then return best end
    end

    if CONFIG.VisibleCheck and not HasLineOfSight(origin, targetPart, character) then return best end

    local score
    if CONFIG.FullCircle then
        score = dist
    else
        score = angle * 10 + dist * 0.01
    end

    if not best or score < best.score then
        return { part = targetPart, score = score }
    end
    return best
end

local function GatherBots()
    local seen = {}
    local out  = {}

    local function add(m)
        if not m or seen[m] then return end
        if not m:IsA("Model") then return end
        if m:HasTag("RagdollRig") then return end
        if not m:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
        seen[m] = true
        table.insert(out, m)
    end

    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("Bot") do add(v) end
    for _, v in CollectionService:GetTagged("NPC") do add(v) end

    for _, v in Workspace:GetDescendants() do
        if v:IsA("Model") and v:GetAttribute("IsBot") == true then
            add(v)
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function GetBestTarget(origin, lookUnit)
    local best = nil

    if CONFIG.TargetPlayers then
        for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
            if IsEnemyPlayer(player) then
                local char = player.Character
                if char then
                    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local hrp  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local part = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp
                    best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, char, part, best)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if CONFIG.TargetBots then
        for _, bot in GatherBots() do
            if IsEnemyBot(bot) then
                local head  = bot:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local hrp   = bot:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local torso = bot:FindFirstChild("Torso") or bot:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                local part  = (CONFIG.TargetHead and head) or hrp or torso
                best = ConsiderTarget(origin, lookUnit, bot, part, best)
            end
        end
    end

    return best and best.part or nil
end

local originalApply = AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism

AimAssist.ApplyBulletMagnetism = function(origin, direction, isAiming)
    if not SilentAimEnabled then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude <= 0 then return direction end

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, direction.Unit)
    if not target then
        return originalApply(origin, direction, isAiming)
    end

    local toTarget = target.Position - origin
    if toTarget.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
        return direction
    end

    return toTarget.Unit * magnitude
end

local originalFireRequestSend = Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send

Packets.Combat.FireRequest.send = function(payload)
    if SilentAimEnabled and payload and payload.Origin and payload.Direction then
        local magnitude = payload.Direction.Magnitude
        if magnitude > 0 then
            local target = GetBestTarget(payload.Origin, payload.Direction.Unit)
            if target then
                payload = {
                    ShotId    = payload.ShotId,
                    Origin    = payload.Origin,
                    Direction = (target.Position - payload.Origin).Unit * magnitude,
                    FireTime  = payload.FireTime,
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return originalFireRequestSend(payload)
end

    WeaponState.MouseDown = prev or false

local function TriggerbotStep()
    if not TriggerbotEnabled or not SilentAimEnabled then return end
    if not WeaponState.CurrentConfig then return end
    if os.clock() < WeaponState.FirstTimeEquipUntil then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold
        and not WeaponState.IsReloading then

        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastAutoReloadAttempt >= CONFIG.AutoReloadCooldown then
            lastAutoReloadAttempt = now
            if WeaponController and WeaponController.Reload then
                pcall(function()
                    WeaponController:Reload()
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if WeaponState.IsReloading then return end
    if WeaponState.CurrentAmmo <= CONFIG.AutoReloadThreshold then return end

    if CONFIG.TriggerbotRequireLMB
        and not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastTriggerFire < CONFIG.TriggerbotMinDelay then return end

    local cam = GetCamera()
    if not cam then return end

    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local look   = cam.CFrame.LookVector

    local target = GetBestTarget(origin, look)
    if not target then return end

    lastTriggerFire = now
    PrimeFire()
end

-- Spammer Core Logic
local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    pcall(function()
        if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local generalChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if generalChannel then
                generalChannel:SendAsync(msg)
                return
            end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local chatRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
        if chatRemote and chatRemote:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
            chatRemote.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
        end
    end)
end

local function generateMessage()

    local subList = categories[randomKey]
    local randomItem = subList[math.random(1, #subList)]

    local finalMsg = ""
    
    if target ~= "" and target ~= " " then
        finalMsg = "@" .. target .. " " .. customPrefix .. " TMKX MEH " .. randomItem .. hiddenChar
    else

end

local spamming = false

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    spamming = not spamming
    if spamming then
        ToggleButton.Text = "STOP SPAM"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        
        local userDelay = tonumber(DelayBox.Text)
        if not userDelay or userDelay < 0.3 then 
            userDelay = 1.2
        end
        
        task.spawn(function()
            while spamming do
                pcall(function()
                    local msg = generateMessage()
                    sendChatMessage(msg)
                end)
                task.wait(userDelay)
            end
        end)
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "START SPAM ($spam)"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90)
    end
end)
